version: Same official SimVascular 2023-05-31 distribution used for baseline; deployed in study runtime
caveats: Installed default global_edge_size=0 and surface_mesh_flag=False differ from docstrings; all important switches set explicitly.
Boundary-layer setter availability does not establish mesh feasibility or achieved thickness. Actual volume and topology will be measured.
No independently named surface optimization control exposed by this TetGenOptions version.
boundary_layer_total_thickness_semantics: Measured native groups verify total thickness = global_edge_size * edge_size_fraction; first layer depends on layer count and ratio.
mesher_frame_issue: Original open-WALL normal orientation yields outward extrusion and overlapping tets; rigid diagonal(-1,-1,1) meshing frame and inverse output restore valid M2/M3 medium meshes. Every candidate still requires independent oriented conformity checks.
VTK8_closest_point_caveat: Use vtkCellLocator, not the VTK 8.1 vtkStaticCellLocator inherited unimplemented method; valid sentinel checks required. Main QA/field audits use VTK 9.

fixed_PLC_volume_only_probe.reason: Native SetWalls cap preservation; surface remeshing is disabled.

no_bisect_false_native_caveat: False is sent as a numeric zero but the native NoBisect setter enables by option name. A separate None/omitted-flag probe is running; actual subdivision must be checked.
